name: THE HEN
note: EXTRACTED from docs/111-scenes-b-and-c.md (THE LINES, C) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 237). Do not edit: change doc 111 and re-run. Pratt's hen, on loan: PRA_E3 option 2 hands it over; it brings the raccoon halfway out of the hole, and goes back to Pratt at THE SALE. Doc 111 writes it one LOOK and one LISTEN.

LOOK_AT.say: A brown hen of firm views. She has been in and out of Mr. Pratt's offers for weeks, and she knows her worth to the penny.

LISTEN_TO.say: A low, continuous remark, like a woman counting change.
